mechanism: The auto-start loop scanned venue inventory against a runtime snapshot taken before the scan and published a plain boolean. A bot stopped after the snapshot (its position left open) or a manual trade that opened a position left /ready and /health reporting a reconciliation that no longer held until the next scan, which can take minutes during adoption.
witness: Model mutant no-epoch-check: scan snapshots bot A with position A, bot A stops, readiness is published from the stale snapshot and read as ready while position A has no live owner.
resolution: Readiness is ReadyAt epoch scannedAt from a snapshot read under the runtime lock together with the epoch; every runtime mutation and every possibly-live manual trade completion bumps the epoch under the lock, and readers require the current epoch and a fresh scan.
